scripts.text:
[Rina]
Hi~!
You are an adventurer like me.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
你好~！
你和我一樣，也是一名冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
I am put under a curse.
I know you want to help me,
but your experience is not enough.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
我中了詛咒。
我知道你想幫忙，可你的冒險經驗還不夠。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
I am not in the good condition,
so what I can do for you
is just like this.
Then, good bye.
Take care~!
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
我現在狀態不太好，能幫你的只有這些了。
再見，保重~！

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Hi~!
You are an adventurer like me.
Well... In fact, I am
put under a strange curse.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
你好~！你和我一樣，也是冒險者。
嗯...其實，我中了一個奇怪的詛咒。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
To release this curse,
somebody needs to do ^800080Oath-taking ceremony^000000
with me,
and then needs to solve
several problems instead of me.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
要解除詛咒，需要有人和我一起進行^800080宣誓儀式^000000，再代替我完成幾項任務。

scripts.text: Let's help ^800080Rina^000000.
Just skip it.
scripts.translation: 不管了

scripts.text:
[Rina]
To help me,
I need a competent adventurer.
If you know those people,
I hope you to introduce them to me later.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
我需要一位有能力的冒險者幫忙。
要是你認識這樣的人，希望能介紹給我。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Are you really going to help me?
Thank you.
You are so brave.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
你真的要幫我嗎？
謝謝你。
你真勇敢。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Then I'll start ^800080Oath-taking ceremony^000000.
 
^787878( A mysterious atmosphere hangs in the air. )^000000
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
那麼我開始^800080宣誓儀式^000000了。
 
^787878（空氣中瀰漫著神秘的氛圍。）^000000

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Blah blah blah...
 
Blah blah blah...
 
^787878( ... This is a strange spell. )^000000
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
Blah blah blah...
 
Blah blah blah...
 
^787878（...這咒語真奇怪。）^000000

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Haaaaah~
^800080Oath-taking ceremony^000000 is done enough now.
Isn't that so simple?
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
Haaaaah~
^800080宣誓儀式^000000完成了。
是不是很簡單？

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Okay, from no on,
you need to go on ^006400a real adventure
to release my curse^000000.
Let me know when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
接下來，你要^006400踏上真正的冒險，解除我的詛咒^000000。
準備好了就告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
What you need to do is
to choose one monster among
^FF0000DEVIRUCHI,^000000 ^FF0000WRAITH DEAD,^000000
^FF0000DULLAHAN,^000000 ^FF0000NIGHTMARE TERROR^000000
and then kill ^0000FF50^000000 monsters
and come back to me.

[Rina]
It must be a tough task,
but you are the right person
who did the oath-taking ceremony.
I hope you succeed.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
任務一定很艱難，但既然完成了宣誓儀式，你就是合適的人選。
希望你能成功。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
You did it.
I can feel that my body is recovering.
But it is not enough.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
你做到了。
我能感覺到我的身體正在恢復。
但還不夠。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
^006400You have one more thing to do.^000000
Let me know when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
^006400你還有一件事要做。^000000
準備好了就告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
I will check one thing.
For this task,
You need to feel the music.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
先確認一件事。
這個任務需要你能聽到音樂。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
You cannot complete the task
without the music.
do you have any problem?
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
聽不到音樂就沒法完成任務。
你這邊沒問題吧？

scripts.text:
- Check! -
^787878- BGM option should be turned on -^000000
^787878- in the game option menu. -^000000
^787878- Please check -^000000
^787878- whether you can listen -^000000
^787878- to the music sound. -^000000
[I'm ready to listen to the BGM.]
scripts.translation: [準備好聽背景音樂了]

scripts.text: [I can't listen to the BGM.]
scripts.translation: [聽不到背景音樂]

scripts.text:
[Rina]
I am so shocked that
you cannot feel the music.
What should we do now...
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
竟然聽不到音樂，我真沒想到。
這下怎麼辦呢...

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Listen carefully
the feelings of it...
I can't hear it,
but you can hear the sound.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
仔細聽，感受這段音樂...
我聽不見，但你能聽到。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
^006400The music you're hearing now^000000
has something to do with the one specific city.
Think carefully ^006400what kind of city^000000
has similar feeling with this music.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
^006400你現在聽到的音樂^000000，與某座城市有關。
仔細想想，^006400是哪座城市^000000的氛圍和這段音樂相似。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
And...
Go to ^006400the city
where you can remind by this music^000000.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
然後...前往^006400這段音樂讓你想到的那座城市^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
After that,
find ^FF0000the strange mark^000000
around the entrances of the city.
Then you can release the curse on me.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
到那裡後，在城市入口附近尋找^FF0000奇怪的標記^000000。
這樣就能解除我的詛咒。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
It must be tough
but I hope you good luck.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
任務一定不容易，祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
You're back~!
My curse has been released.
Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
你回來了~！
我的詛咒已經解除了。
非常感謝你。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Your bag is too full.
I have a present for you
so make your bag lighter.
I'll wait for you.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
你的背包太滿了。
我有禮物送你，先減輕些負重吧。
我等你。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
This is the present for you.
It's not a big one
but please take it
as a token of my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
這是給你的禮物。
雖然不貴重，還是請收下，表達我的一點謝意。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
I'll take a rest for a few days
and then I'll go on an adventure.
See you again.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
我歇幾天，就繼續去冒險。
再見。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Thank you for releasing my curse.
I'll take a rest for a few days
and then go on an adventure again.
Have a happy day~!
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
謝謝你解除了我的詛咒。
歇幾天後，我就繼續去冒險。
祝你今天愉快~！

scripts.text: - I found ^0000FFthe strange mark^000000. -
scripts.translation: - 我找到了^0000FF奇怪的標記^000000。 -

scripts.text:
- I can definitely feel that
- ^0000FFRina^000000 has been released
- from the curse.
- ^006400Let's go back to Rina!^000000
scripts.translation:
- 我能清楚地感覺到，
- ^0000FF莉娜^000000已經擺脫了詛咒。
- ^006400回去找莉娜吧！^000000

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
.......
 
^787878( No response. )^000000

[Rina's Little Friend]
Hi.
I guess you're the trustworthy friend.
Are you here to make a deal with me?
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小夥伴]
你好。
我想你就是那個值得信賴的朋友。
你是來和我做交易的嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不是

scripts.text: What do you mean?
scripts.translation: 你這是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Hmm.
The material is not enough.
Please check the things you need.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小夥伴]
嗯，材料不夠。
再檢查一下需要的東西吧。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Cool... if you give me the materials
I will start it right now.
Are you ready for it?
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小夥伴]
好...把材料給我，我就開始。
準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, let's start it.
scripts.translation: 好，開始吧

scripts.text: No, stop it.
scripts.translation: 不，停下

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Heh. It's boring.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小夥伴]
呵。真無聊。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Okay, I will start it now.
 
^787878( A mysterious atmosphere hangs in the air. )^000000
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小夥伴]
好，現在開始。
 
^787878（空氣中瀰漫著神秘的氛圍。）^000000

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Life is given to the egg.
Aaaaah~ I got to take some rest.
Good bye~!
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小夥伴]
這枚蛋已經獲得生命了。
Aaaaah~我得歇一歇。
再見~！

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
It seems that you have quite interesting things.
I need to take some rest.
Good bye~!
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小夥伴]
看來你有一些挺有趣的東西。
我得休息一下了。
再見~！

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
There was no change.
I didn't mean to do it,
but I'm sorry...
I hope to see you again, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小夥伴]
什麼變化都沒有。
雖然不是故意的，還是對不起...
希望還能見到你，朋友。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Hmm.
It became a dish.
Looks delicious.
Then, good bye~!
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小夥伴]
嗯，變成一道菜了。
看起來挺好吃。
再見~！

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
You are here just to see my cute looks?
Aren't you peeking at Rina
pretending to see me?
It's funny... haha~
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小夥伴]
你只是來看我可愛的模樣？
該不會假裝來看我，其實在偷看莉娜吧？
真有意思...haha~

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Huh?!
I never told you before?
Then listen carefully.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小夥伴]
咦？！
我之前沒告訴過你嗎？
那你仔細聽好了。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
I have a
special ability.
It's to give a special strength
to ^0000FFthe egg^000000.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小夥伴]
我有一種特殊能力，能賦予^0000FF蛋^000000特別的力量。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Well, I cannot do that unlimitedly.
There is no magic that is done forever.
So I need some additional cost.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小夥伴]
不過，這種能力可不能沒完沒了地用。
魔法總有極限，所以還需要額外的費用。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
And I cannot sure
to what the egg will be changed.
It may be end in failure
and it can be something like Pet Egg.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小夥伴]
我也不能保證蛋會變成什麼。
可能失敗，也可能變成寵物蛋之類的東西。

scripts.text: Ask the cost.
scripts.translation: 詢問費用

scripts.text: Stop listening because it feels like a trick.
scripts.translation: 像是騙局，不聽了

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Well... I don't really care.
Good bye.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小夥伴]
嗯... 我其實不太在意。
再見。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Do you want to make a deal?
You need
^0000FF1 Egg^000000, ^0000FF20 Light Granule^000000 and
^B8860B400,000 Zeny.

[Rina's Little Friend]
Do you want to make a deal?
You need
^0000FF1 Egg^000000, ^0000FF20 Light Granule^000000 and
^B8860B450,000 Zeny^000000.

[Rina's Little Friend]
Do you want to make a deal?
You need
^0000FF1 Egg^000000, ^0000FF20 Light Granule^000000 and
^B8860B480,000 Zeny^000000.

[Rina's Little Friend]
Do you want to make a deal?
You need
^0000FF1 Egg^000000, ^0000FF20 Light Granule^000000 and
^B8860B500,000 Zeny^000000.

[Rina's Little Friend]
If you are interested
make that zeny and come again.
Haha...
I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小夥伴]
感興趣的話，湊夠Zeny再來吧。
Haha...
我等著你。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Ahem!
Why? Are you surprised to see me speaking?
Well, I understand you.
Only the person who did
the oath-taking ceremony can talk with me.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小夥伴]
咳！怎麼，我會說話讓你很驚訝？
可以理解，只有參加過宣誓儀式的人，才能跟我說話。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
If Rina's curse is released,
I can also
suggest you
an interesting thing.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小夥伴]
等莉娜的詛咒解除了，我還能告訴你一件有趣的事。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
I will let you know
the detailed explanation later.
Then see you later, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小夥伴]
詳細的事以後再說。
回頭見，朋友。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
I'm a traveler
and I often visit ^8B4513Prontera^000000.
Hmm, I think I might
see you around here before.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
我是個旅行者，經常來^8B4513普隆德拉^000000。
嗯...以前好像在這裡見過你。

scripts.text: Listen some more.
scripts.translation: 再聽一會兒

scripts.text: Just ignore it.
scripts.translation: 直接無視

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
As I expected,
you are a silent person. Ha ha.
Good bye.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
果然不愛說話啊，哈哈。
再見。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
A few days ago,
I saw a new adventurer
who were standing
near the ^8B4513Cathedral^000000.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
幾天前，我看到一位新來的冒險者，站在^8B4513大教堂^000000附近。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
That adventurer seemed pretty.
But...
I feel some strange energy
so I don't come close to that person.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
那位冒險者挺漂亮。
可我感覺到一股奇怪的力量，就沒敢靠近。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Look like
you're interested in
that new adventurer?
Or that is just your face look. Ha ha.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
你似乎對那位新來的冒險者很感興趣？
還是你平時就是這副表情？哈哈。

scripts.text: I'm interested in it.
scripts.translation: 我對此很感興趣

scripts.text: I don't care at all.
scripts.translation: 我完全不在乎

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Ah~ I see~!
Then, Good bye.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
啊~ 原來如此~！
那麼，再見。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Just as I expected!
You can find
that new adventurer
on the way to the ^8B4513Cathedral^000000
at the direction of 1o'clock in ^8B4513Prontera^000000.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
果然！
往^8B4513大教堂^000000走，就能找到那位新來的冒險者。
就在^8B4513普隆德拉^0000001點鐘方向。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
She was carrying
^800080a big egg thing^000000.
That's what I know.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
她抱著^800080一個大大的蛋狀物^000000。
我知道的就這些。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
A while ago,
I met a lady
and she said she has been
under a strange curse.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
不久前，我遇到一位女士，她說自己中了奇怪的詛咒。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
I wanted to help her
but my experience is not enough.
So I couldn't help her.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
我本想幫她，可冒險經驗還不夠，沒能幫上忙。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
If you are more than
level ^0000FF40^000000,
go to the ^8B4513Cathedral^000000
at the direction of 1'o clock.
I hope you can help her...
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
如果你超過^0000FF40^000000級，就去1點鐘方向的^8B4513大教堂^000000吧。
希望你能幫到她...
